title: Guardrail Orchestrator: VPC IaC CI health gates and policy automation
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Implement a Guardrail Orchestrator for VPC Terraform pipelines that enforces linting, policy-as-code checks (OPA/Conftest), drift/health probes, and safe apply rollouts for Private (VPC) deployments. The goal is to reduce failed or unsafe terraform applies in customer VPCs and provide clear remediation paths and playbooks for on-call engineers.
background: We operate private VPC deployments for customers where terraform runs can have high blast radius. Current pipelines surface plan outputs but lack a unified policy layer for cost/privilege/network changes, and we have recurring incidents from mis-scoped subnets, internet-exposed services, and IAM role misconfigurations during upgrades. Existing repos run ad-hoc conftest checks; we need a centralized orchestrator and standardized gate definitions across all private modules.
proposal: Build a reusable CI pipeline component (Guardrail Orchestrator) that integrates with GitHub Actions and our internal self-hosted runners to execute stages: (1) format + static lint (tflint, terraform fmt), (2) plan in isolated workspace, (3) policy evals using OPA + Conftest policies (network, iam, cost, tagging), (4) automated health preflight (pre-apply drift scan + smoke deploy sim for canary), (5) gated apply with canary + automated rollback on health regression. Surface results in PR status, Slack notifications, and Console incident link. Provide a module registry of policy packs and an authoring guide for new policies.
acceptance_criteria: Repository template includes Guardrail Orchestrator workflow that runs on PR and push to release branches
PR checks must include terraform fmt, tflint, plan, conftest policy-eval, and a preflight health probe step
Policy failures block merge and add structured comment with failing assertions and remediation hints
Apply step supports a canary mode (10% of resources or specific subnets) and an automated rollback hook tied to a health check window
Audit logs record policy decisions and plan diffs to the private control plane for customers with Private deployments
At least 6 canonical OPA/Conftest policies shipped (network-exposure, non-routable-subnets, public-ips, iam-principals-with-admin, kms-never-plaintext, cost-estimate-threshold), with tests
On-call runbook created and linked; mean time to remediate (MTTR) target defined and measured after rollout
tasks: Design Conftest/OPA policy schema and mapping to terraform plan JSON
Create GitHub Actions workflow templates + reusable composite actions for tflint/format/plan/policy-eval/health-probe/apply
Implement preflight health probe: lightweight k8s aws-sdk checks and terraform drift scanner integration
Author initial policy pack and unit tests (rego + conftest fixtures)
Integrate with Console audit API to push policy evaluation events
Create canary apply orchestration and rollback hook (feature flag driven)
Add Slack/GitHub PR comment reporter with remediation links
Document developer guide and module migration plan
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: False positive policy rejections could block urgent fixes. Mitigation: provide emergency bypass with strong audit trail and require two-signer approval for bypass
Risk: Plan JSON variations across terraform versions break tests. Mitigation: pin supported terraform versions in workflow matrix and add plan-normalizer pre-step
Risk: Health probe may increase pipeline runtime. Mitigation: make probes configurable per repo and fast-fail by sampling targeted resources
Risk: Large customers may require custom policies. Mitigation: create policy extension points and a documented contract for custom policy packs

decisions: Use OPA/Rego as primary policy language with Conftest for local dev and policy runner in CI
Support both GitHub Actions and a future internal runner; start with Actions for faster rollout
Canary apply will be declarative: repo owners declare canary target resources via a small manifest; orchestrator handles partial apply and reconciliation
Emergency bypass exists but requires a 2-person approval and automatic audit log entry in Console
qa_plan: Unit tests for all policies (rego) with Conftest fixtures. E2E tests run in ephemeral AWS accounts: create sample VPC with module, open one subnet to public IP in PR to validate policy fails, then validate that bypass and remediation flow works. Run synthetic pipeline against private-modules before rollout.
monitoring_and_telemetry: Emit policy.evaluation.* events to Console with tags: repo, branch, policy_pack, decision. Measure blocked merges, avg time to fix policy failures, and number of bypasses. Add dashboard in Console and alert when blocked merges spike > 5x baseline.
rollback_plan: Rollback triggers on failed health probe or manual rollback request. For automated rollback, orchestrator will run terraform destroy only for resources created in canary window and restore previous state using saved plan snapshot. Manual rollback procedure documented in runbook.
